description: This file implements a class for managing Bzip2 compression and decompression within the ADOdb library. It provides methods to set and get compression parameters, and to perform compression/decompression on data, intended for session management.

classes.name: ADODB_Compress_Bzip2
classes.description: A class to handle Bzip2 compression/decompression with configurable settings.

methods.name: getBlockSize
methods.description: Returns the current block size used for compression.

methods.name: setBlockSize
methods.description: Sets the block size for compression, restricting it to 1-9.

methods.name: getWorkLevel
methods.description: Returns the current work level parameter for compression.

methods.name: setWorkLevel
methods.description: Sets the work level parameter, constrained between 0 and 250.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum data length for applying compression.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Sets the minimum data length threshold for compression.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Compresses data if it exceeds the minimum length using configured parameters.
